subject: MINIDORA language, meaning, judgment, execution and memory engine

route_contract: Input recognizes コードを読んで:/：, コードを評価して:/：, コードを検証して:/： and ASCII-case-insensitive code-read:, code-evaluate:, code-verify:. It preserves every body byte after the header newline; malformed trailing JSON is never trimmed into a new request.

Read accepts exactly 情報源. Evaluate accepts 情報源, 引数 and optional 最大手数. Verify accepts 情報源, 1–32 試験 cases and optional 最大手数. Root/source/value schemas and duplicate JSON keys are checked before execution.

Whole-source parser admits exactly one top-level function with simple arguments; validates dead branches and all syntax before interpretation; emits selected structure rows for statements, calls and comparisons with UTF-8 byte columns/source segments.

Native evaluator supports bounded scalar/list/dictionary expressions, subscripts, + - * // %, unary + - not, and/or, chained comparisons including membership, conditional expressions, assignments, if/elif/else, for/else, break/continue/pass/return, first docstring, and allowlisted abs/len/min/max/sum/range/sorted/list/all/any.

Imports, attributes, decorators, annotations, defaults, nested functions, special arguments, indirect/keyword calls, unsupported syntax and out-of-envelope values are rejected. No host Python, exec, eval, subprocess, compiler or external effect is used by the product route.

Reports contain exact source and source digest, function signature, AST metrics/structure, operation result, argument/case digests, actual JSON/status, branch rows, diagnostics, line and step count. Core stores the report artifact and sends the report through the existing content/render/history path.
Verification reports per-case matching only. Canonical typed comparison distinguishes bool from int. A finite match is not universal correctness or static type safety.

resource_envelope.max_steps: 1..=200000; default 50000; each verification case receives that finite step limit
resource_envelope.request_deadline: Observed at evaluator step boundaries; Core also enforces its overall request deadline
resource_envelope.mid_evaluation_cancellation: No polling callback is currently passed to the evaluator; not implemented

runtime_claim_boundary.meaning_of_COMPUTED: The declared bounded read/evaluation/check operation completed as recorded. Verification all_matched concerns only supplied finite cases.
runtime_claim_boundary.host_runner_or_new_execution_permission: NONE; no product Python, exec, eval, compiler, subprocess or external-effect adapter
runtime_claim_boundary.static_name_and_type_analysis: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; runtime failures such as unbound names are diagnosed only on evaluated paths

reference_comparison.scope: Authored finite QC against the frozen custom evaluator and CPython ast.parse(feature_version=(3,11)); not independent held-out acceptance or general Python compatibility.

resolved_observations: The first normal CLI reference run used a stale pre-build executable; the binary was rebuilt and the final comparison rerun against the current executable.
Parenthesized expressions initially shortened parent statement source spans. AST node spans and full surface spans were separated; focused unit and CPython comparison now match.

Large integer sequence indexes initially produced TypeError instead of IndexError. BigInt-based normalization now distinguishes type errors from out-of-range errors; component test and legacy comparison pass.

An input test initially treated a valid header with trailing invalid JSON body text as Unknown. The test now asserts the exact body is retained for strict downstream rejection, avoiding silent text loss.
The first strict Clippy pass reported two style diagnostics; both were corrected and the final warning-denied pass passed.
An early json! fixture sorted dictionary keys before testing insertion order; final order fixtures use raw JSON text, and the native route preserves insertion order.

initial_failed_runs.resolution: Two style diagnostics corrected; final warning-denied Clippy passed.
Input test oracle corrected to assert exact preservation of trailing body text; production parser correctly did not discard it.

retained_evidence.failed_attempts_and_previous_reference_s: Included in the asset manifest; no state/evidence directories were deleted.

requirement_boundary.full_acceptance_gap: General code creation/explanation/revision/repair; complete inherited parser/interpreter/checker and Python runtime compatibility; static name/type analysis; mid-evaluation cancellation; unseen task quality; full resource/target/Unicode compatibility and the complete required B07 population remain unverified.
